description: Ensure config authoring leaves main before changing repository files.
prompt: Add a 14-day approximate unique count of listing_id to the existing GCP user activity features. Use the existing user_activities source and user_id key rather than creating a second GroupBy. Make the smallest appropriate versioned change, compile it, and validate it with the Zipline eval command. Do not modify unrelated configurations.

judge_criteria: The agent detects that the starting branch is main and checks out a newly created branch before the first repository file change.
The agent extends and versions the existing GroupBy instead of creating a duplicate for the same source and key.
The requested 14-day approximate unique-count feature follows repository conventions and avoids unrelated edits.
Compilation and eval outcomes are reported accurately.
